title: Velo Cherry Ice Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Cherry Ice Nicotine Pouches combine the bold, fruity flavour of ripe Cherry with a cooling note that adds freshness and balance. The result is a pouch that tastes sweet, crisp and refreshing, making it a strong choice for fans of fruit blends. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering an easy and practical option wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of strengths and flavour profiles. Cherry Ice is offered here in a Medium 10mg strength, delivering a more potent release compared with lighter pouch formats. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
